name: rentflow
description: RentFlow — an autonomous rent-settlement agent that pays daily rent micropayments over the x402 standard, settling on Hedera testnet.

scripts.test: npm run test -w shared -w packages/landlord-server -w packages/rentflow-agent --if-present
scripts.dev:landlord: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w packages/landlord-server
scripts.dev:agent: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w packages/rentflow-agent
scripts.seed: npm run build:shared && npm run seed -w packages/landlord-server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared -w packages/landlord-server -w packages/rentflow-agent --if-present
